description: What mysql.slow_log recorded for the same statements as each log (log_output=FILE,TABLE, long_query_time=0, log_slow_admin_statements=ON), read with CAST(query_time AS CHAR) and HEX(sql_text) from throwaway lab containers: MySQL 5.7.44 (log_timestamps=UTC), MySQL 8.4.13 (log_slow_extra=ON, log_timestamps=SYSTEM, TZ=America/Sao_Paulo) and MariaDB 11.4.13 (log_slow_verbosity=query_plan,innodb,explain, TZ=Asia/Kolkata). statements: [db, sql_text, query time in microseconds] per row, in table order.

SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (1) ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 10
